name: bulkhead
description: Blocks shell commands a coding agent is about to run that cannot be undone: rm -rf or rsync --delete through an empty variable, deletes of a drive root, home, app data or .git, link-following deletes, and pkill patterns that hit other sessions. Claude gets the reason and the safe form and usually rewrites the command. Also keeps parallel sessions from killing each other's processes, ports and git tree.
